Granbull

Fairy

Johto · Generation 2

Granbull is a Fairy-type Fairy Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 48.7 kg. It evolves from Snubbull. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 450.
